correctness.rationale: The proof reconstructs both endpoints analytically. On each side of the centered support, y^2 is bounded by the extreme deviation times |y|, and the endpoint atoms bound those extreme deviations in terms of the common one-sided first moment; this gives the lower constant. The upper constant is Cauchy--Schwarz against the binary indicator above the mean. Equality conditions force the stated attainment behavior. Continuity on the connected strict-support cone gives the complete intervals.

value.rationale: The result completely solves a natural support-geometry problem for two standard dispersion measures under a fixed categorical probability profile. It supplies both a nontrivial positive lower barrier and a sharp upper barrier, with explicit equality and nonattainment structure. The equal-weight corollary gives a simple cardinality law and shows exactly when the universal MAD<=SD bound can be approached.
